Old Biff steals the DeLorean, gives his younger self the Gray's Sports Almanac, returns. The timeline changes around them: 1985 becomes alt-1985 (Biff's wealth, George dead, Lorraine married to Biff). Marty/Doc return to this alt-1985, then go back to November 12 1955 to steal the almanac back and burn it; timeline begins restoring."}, {"id": "allocation", "title": "Fixture allocations", "kind": "test_fixture", "text": "Revisions: rA (original history through 2015), rB (almanac-given, alt-history), rC (almanac burned, restoring toward rA).
